title: A decisive action summarized instead of shown weakens the reader's movie (non-blocking).
purpose: Exercises the reader_movie mode and the exploratory tier. reader_movie stays perceptual, not universal taste QA (ADR 0011): it asks only whether the reader can perceive the decisive beat, and even as a hard clause it is non-blocking here because the fixture is exploratory (ADR 0015).

clauses.statement: The turning action of the scene is rendered so the reader can perceive it, not summarized after the fact.

satisfaction_criterion.statement: The decisive action carries at least one concrete perceptual anchor at the moment it happens.

prose: By the time the guards arrived it was already over. Later, Serra would tell herself she had done what was necessary.

expect.note: Advisory requirement: a lost clause is a WARNING Critique (ADR 0019), never repair-eligible. Exploratory tier: a regression here is reviewed, never gates a merge.
